interface.longDescription: Scaffold, develop, deploy, and publish roster apps end-to-end. Five focused skills cover app creation, entity development (objects, fields, logic, layouts, front components), remote/sync/deploy operations, marketplace publishing assets, and workspace data retrieval via MCP. The bundled roster docs MCP server keeps guidance current, and the setup helper wires per-user workspace MCP with OAuth in one command.
